title: 2012 Lexus IS F vs 2012 BMW M3: Comparison Test
text:
# 2012 Lexus IS F vs 2012 BMW M3: Comparison Test

The 2012 Lexus IS F's 5.0-liter V-8 makes 416 hp; the 2012 BMW M3's 4.0-liter V-8 makes 414 hp.

The IS F uses an eight-speed automatic, while the E92 and E90 M3 offer a six-speed manual or a seven-speed dual-clutch.

At the strip the M3 reached 60 mph in 4.3 seconds and the IS F in 4.6 seconds.

The IS F was sold from the 2008 to the 2014 model year; this generation of M3 ran from 2008 to 2013.
